data.body: **[P2] Propagate fatal MDC restoration failures to the invocation caller.** On an asynchronous executor, if `restore.close()` throws a direct or wrapped `VirtualMachineError`/`ThreadDeath`, this `finally` still completes `result` with the selected success or pending output. The fatal reaches only the worker’s uncaught-exception handler, so Lambda may receive a normal response. Complete `result` exceptionally with the fatal before rethrowing it, and change the async restoration test to assert that the caller observes the same fatal.
